continuityReviews.scope: The ordered replacement kernel, native map adapter and NewTurn day0→1 hook; not all game/combat/GUI behavior.
continuityReviews.notes: All five listed implementation files have exactly the same SHA256 as their retained Final8 full-touch build source ledger. Final9 changed Sorceress combat context and dwelling XP participation; Final10 changed only Cave Grail web availability; Final11 changed only mobile local-load role restoration and player state publication. Those changes are outside the replacement kernel/day-one callback. Final11 authored maps independently observed three/five replacements at the allowed sites, unchanged on reload, and actual solo/hotseat next-turn control. The historical Final8 101-object/8-shared143 and seed-reproducibility observations remain Final8-only; no equal RNG sequence across builds or original WoG seed equivalence is claimed. New supplementary recruitment placements alter initial map content and may alter RNG draw outcomes; their full template envelope is checked separately. Final12 changes only the Weakness45 p276/p284 magnitude helper. This combat magnitude correction cannot change source replacement matching, placement, source ordering or day-one idempotency; the five source anchors remain byte-identical. Data corrections H+309/310 and Fear253/306/330 affect creature bonus carriers, not object geometry or replacement policy. Their native effects require separate scoped proofs.
